Generate Pitcher Performance Report

Source: R/generatepitcher.R
generate_pitcher.Rd

This function fetches Statcast data for a given pitcher or list of pitchers, calculates key performance metrics, and generates a strike zone heatmap displaying the most frequently used pitch type and whiff rate for each zone.

Usage

generate_pitcher(player_ids, start_date, end_date, game_types = c("R", "PO"))

Arguments

player_ids

A vector of numeric player IDs representing the pitchers to analyze.

start_date

A character string representing the start date of the data range in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

end_date

A character string representing the end date of the data range in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

game_types

Character vector of Baseball Savant game type codes to include. Default c("R", "PO") is regular season and postseason; add "S" to include spring training.

Value

For a single ID, a ggplot object showing the strike zone heatmap with the most frequently used pitch type and whiff rate for each zone (or NULL, invisibly, when no data is found). For several IDs, a named list with one such plot per pitcher, named by player ID. Additionally, tables summarizing general pitching statistics and pitch-specific statistics are drawn for each pitcher.

Details

The function performs the following steps for each pitcher separately:

  • Fetches player names using the MLB Stats API.

  • Fetches Statcast data from Baseball Savant for the pitcher and date range. Only start_date and end_date restrict the dates; there is no season filter.

  • Calculates general statistics: batters faced, walk rate, strikeout rate and whiff rate.

  • Generates pitch-specific statistics: pitch count, usage, average velocity and whiff rate.

  • Creates a strike zone heatmap of the most frequently used pitch type and the whiff rate in each of the nine Statcast strike zones.

Definitions:

  • Plate appearances (batters faced) are rows with a non-empty events value, excluding baserunning events such as caught_stealing_* and pickoff_* and truncated_pa.

  • Strikeout rate = (strikeout + strikeout_double_play) / PA.

  • Walk rate = (walk + intent_walk) / PA. Hit-by-pitch is not counted as a walk.

  • Whiff rate = whiffs / swings. Whiffs are swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, foul_tip and missed_bunt; swings are whiffs plus foul, foul_bunt and hit_into_play. Counting foul tips as whiffs matches Baseball Savant's Whiff%.

The heatmap is drawn from the catcher's view: zone 1 is top-left (third-base side, high) and zone 9 is bottom-right (first-base side, low).

Note

This function requires an active internet connection to fetch data from the MLB Stats API and Baseball Savant.

Examples

# \donttest{
# Example usage:
pitcher_ids <- c(543037)  # Gerrit Cole
start_date <- "2024-01-01"
end_date <- "2024-12-31"
generate_pitcher(player_ids = pitcher_ids, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)
#> Fetching Statcast data for pitcher 543037 ...


# }
